values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations. 'Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period.' Not allowed near developed sites (campgrounds, picnic areas, trailheads); keep the campsite within 150 ft of the road.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins ('Recreationist can camp anywhere in the National Forest outside a designated campground'; 'Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period'; 'Dispersed camping is not allowed in the vicinity of developed recreation areas such as campgrounds, picnic areas, or trailheads ... Keep your campsite within 150 feet from a roadway'), read 2026-10-21

flags: Access criteria (AWH 2026-10-21 4WD rule, human decides; likely DROP): Virginia DWR's own Long Run Road page (https://dwr.virginia.gov/vbwt/sites/long-run-road-forest-rd-72/, read 2026-10-21) says 'The road is unpaved, winding, and remote. Contact the U.S. Forest Service North River Ranger District at (540) 432-0187 to check on road conditions and closures prior to arrival.' This is an agency 4WD recommendation for FR 72, the only road to all six Long Run Road sites (520, 519, 522, 56, 57, 58); EKKO is not 4WD.
